current_model_choice.why_base_not_posttrained: The official Base repository explicitly targets fine-tuning/research and avoids silently importing a post-training policy as the starting cognition authority. Exact revision, tokenizer, processor, weight hashes and runtime build remain mandatory before executable credit.

observed_model_facts.architecture_summary: 6 x (3 x Gated DeltaNet+FFN -> 1 x gated attention+FFN)

legacy_training_donor_boundary.admitted_donor_strength: deterministic corpus generation + structural validity + exact uniqueness + zero exact/prompt cross-split overlap
legacy_training_donor_boundary.migration_rule: Reuse mechanisms and valid rows only through current Typed Entry / provenance / family-split / evidence admission; do not revive Mini Entity as a competing product or Together as a current execution authority.

training_objective.goal: Teach a replaceable approximately-0.8B HCU cognition module to emit protocol-valid candidate cognition, preserve unresolved Hyperposition alternatives, consume/express J-Space vector-control traces, and respect deterministic truth/effect boundaries without becoming canonical state or effect authority.
training_objective.non_goal: Do not train the model to claim internal semantic facts that have not passed model-specific causal evidence gates.
training_objective.effect_law: Model output remains ActionCandidate/projection only; EffectGate + EffectJournal retain real-effect authority.

curriculum_families.purpose: Preserve general language, reasoning, coding, multilingual, formatting and instruction competence during specialization.
curriculum_families.admission: High-quality general/reconstructed instruction examples with provenance and contamination checks; keep evaluation families disjoint.
curriculum_families.why: Current external SFT literature reports general-capability loss from narrow fine-tuning and improved preservation when screened retention data is mixed with new-domain data.

curriculum_families.purpose: Typed Entry, causal-event vs admission identity, generation/provenance rejection, UNKNOWN preservation, ActionCandidate/EffectGate split and no self-granted capabilities.
hard_negatives: model output presented as canonical fact

curriculum_families.purpose: GRID10/COGSIM10/WM_TEST/NESTED_SIM/SCALEOUT typed coordination without equating logical cells to physical model concurrency.
hard_negatives: logical module count reported as resident-model count

curriculum_families.purpose: Preserve multiple unresolved alternatives with evidence/provenance bindings until a discriminator closes them.
curriculum_families.teaching_form: Candidate-set traces with explicit unresolved status, competing hypotheses, falsifier/evidence requests, and deterministic collapse criteria.
curriculum_families.forbidden_shortcut: Majority, recurrence, confidence or fluent explanation alone may not collapse Hyperposition into fact.

curriculum_families.purpose: Learn to consume/emit JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1-compatible candidate traces and distinguish intervention from observation.
curriculum_families.positive_rows: Only rows derived from exact admitted causal traces at exact model/runtime/source identity.
curriculum_families.promotion_gate: Current strict Qwen3-0.6B cross-task gate successor chain, presently v6 at observed main, or a newer admitted successor. A source-only green gate does not itself create rows or runtime truth.

curriculum_families.purpose: Convert only evidence-qualified Typed Entry -> route -> verified loader consumption -> model execution -> InferenceReceipt -> J-Space/GWT trace into TrainingTrace candidates.
curriculum_families.admission: Exact causal identity, family identity, source/model/runtime hashes and control identities required; ambiguous lineage fails closed.

curriculum_families.purpose: Require learned protocol and abstract-state behavior to transfer across held-out task grammars/families rather than memorizing one syntax or codebook.
curriculum_families.design: Family-level split; lexical disjointness; target x code x polarity factorial; proof-topology and exact token-position matching; rank-consistent geometry; rank-complete nuisance coverage.

mixture_policy.rule: Do not guess a single permanent mixture ratio from intuition. Use small zero-cost pilot ablations on calibration/validation only, select by a multi-objective retention + HCU/J-Space score, then freeze the mixture before opening holdout.
selection_constraints: general-retention regression must remain within preregistered tolerance
EntityOS authority/fail-closed tests must not regress
J-Space causal/OOD validation must improve beyond base
no ratio tuning on final holdout
external_research_basis: arXiv:2506.09428 — screened retention data mixed with new-domain SFT to mitigate catastrophic forgetting
arXiv:2508.11953 — data-mixture weights can be optimized from smaller-scale mixture experiments rather than assumed

split_and_goodman_law.rule: All descendants sharing the same execution/source/model/intervention ancestry stay in one split. Paraphrase/template/output-code variants from the same causal event do not become independent evidence.
split_and_goodman_law.holdout_opening: Only after model/base identity, data mixture, curriculum, rank/geometry estimator and acceptance thresholds are frozen.

hyperposition_to_training_encoding.loss_semantics: Penalize premature collapse where source truth is unresolved; reward exact preservation of alternatives and explicit evidence request. Resolution targets are admitted only when the source causal/evidence boundary actually closes the alternative set.
hyperposition_to_training_encoding.anti_hallucination_rule: Generated synthetic narrative may teach method/format, but cannot label an unresolved external fact as resolved.

full_ft_strategy.primary_candidate: Full-parameter fine-tuning after admitted dataset > 0 and exact checkpoint/runtime identity; LoRA remains a useful ablation, not proof of equivalence.
forgetting_controls: multiple seeds/pilot mixtures where zero-cost compute allows
fail closed if specialization improves while broad retention or authority behavior materially regresses
full_ft_strategy.important_model_specific_caution: Qwen3.5-0.8B uses a hybrid DeltaNet/attention architecture. Existing Qwen3-0.6B J-Space layer numbers/vectors do not transfer by assumption; Qwen3.5 requires fresh model-specific hidden-state and intervention calibration.

quantization_plan.source_fact: Current llama.cpp documents Q4_K_M quantization from a high-precision GGUF and warns that quantization may introduce accuracy loss; it supports optional importance matrices.
rules: Never requantize an already quantized checkpoint for final acceptance when high-precision source is available.
Measure base/tuned acceptance before quantization, then rerun protocol, general-retention and J-Space model-specific tests on exact Q4_K_M bytes.
Do not transfer hidden-state/J-Space causal credit from BF16/F16 to Q4_K_M by name or ancestry alone.
Bind GGUF hash, tokenizer/processor identity, llama.cpp commit/build and quantization command/parameters into the final receipt.
If Q4_K_M causes causal-geometry or protocol regressions, keep the high-precision checkpoint as the scientific reference and treat quantized deployment as failed until repaired.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 2 now has a current EntityOS/HCU-native training curriculum for Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base that treats historical ClayCog v2 only as a structurally valid donor, routes future rows through the canonical evidence-qualified dataset path, teaches Hyperposition as unresolved alternatives rather than forced labels, binds J-Space training examples to exact causal traces, uses family/provenance split isolation, protects general capability through retention-mixture ablations, and makes Q4_K_M a separately revalidated deployment artifact rather than inheriting full-precision causal credit.
strongest_counterhypothesis: A small 0.8B full-FT checkpoint may learn the protocol vocabulary and output format without acquiring model-internal cross-task abstract-state control; the strict causal gates and held-out family transfer are therefore required and training loss alone cannot adjudicate the claim.
next_exact_action: Do not launch training. First obtain an evidence-qualified positive Distillery/TrainingTrace token path and exact Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base checkpoint/tokenizer/processor identity. In parallel, keep the already dispatched Qwen3-0.6B frozen structural runtime run unchanged; when runner transport executes it, preserve raw evidence and feed only admitted causal traces into the new curriculum.
